name: OG Connectors – Pixel & CAPI, UTM Attribution, GA4, SMTP & Alerts
author: onlygrow

sections.description:
“I installed the pixel, but I can’t tell if it fires or what it’s tracking.”

“Meta and Google can’t see all my sales, so they spend my budget badly.”

“My WordPress emails land in spam or never arrive, and I’m the last to know.”

OG Connectors is the single place where your site keeps every connection it makes to the outside world — webhooks, messaging, AI keys, ad pixels and Google Analytics — each one tested, with its status and its expiry date, ready for every plugin on your site to use.

  • Email (SMTP): any mail server (your hosting, Gmail, Brevo…), test email, backup connections, routing by sender, automatic retry, simulation mode for staging sites.
  • Email log: every email with its headers and body, resend in one click, which plugin sent it, the SMTP conversation and how to fix a failure.
  • Email control: BCC, Reply-To and your own headers, deliver only to the domains you choose, turn off WordPress emails one by one.
  • Pixels & tags: Meta, TikTok, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity, rules for where each one loads, Meta domain verification.
  • Conversions API: Meta events from the browser and your server with the same event ID, email and phone hashed.
  • Conversion events: page view, lead, sign-up, search, add to cart, purchase, ready for WooCommerce, a sale is never counted twice.
  • Tracking: every conversion sent with the platform’s answer, filters, CSV export.
  • UTM Attribution: which ad or link brought each conversion, with our free OG Analytics.
  • Alerts: dozens of WordPress events (new user, failed login, plugin deleted, updates available…) to Telegram, email or webhooks, with your own templates.
  • Webhooks & automation: n8n, Zapier, Make, Pabbly Connect or any URL.
  • AI keys: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, tested when saved.
  • Connection health: test button, status and expiry date, an alert when a connection fails and when it works again.
  • Activity: a log of every connection, search, resend or delete many at once.
  • Dashboard: totals of your deliveries and tracking, a chart by day, a by-time-of-day grid.
  • Diagnose: a green, amber and red checklist, SPF, DKIM and DMARC of your domain, other plugins loading pixels, a report for support.
  • AI agents: let AI agents read your connections and activity (WordPress Abilities API), act only if you allow it.
sections.faq:
External services: does OG Connectors send data to other services?

Only to the services you connect yourself, and only what each connection needs. Nothing is sent until you add a connection, and nothing is sent to us unless you say yes (see OnlyGrow below).

  • Meta (Facebook / Instagram) pixel and Conversions API. With a Meta connection, your pages load the Meta pixel (connect.facebook.net) and send the events you choose (page view, sign-up, purchase…) from the visitor’s browser to facebook.com. With a Conversions API token, the same events are also sent from your server to graph.facebook.com, with the visitor’s email and phone hashed (SHA-256). Terms · Privacy
  • TikTok pixel. With a TikTok connection, your pages load the TikTok pixel (analytics.tiktok.com) and send the events you choose. Terms · Privacy
  • Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. With a GA4 or Tag Manager connection, your pages load Google’s tag (googletagmanager.com) and send page views and the events you choose to Google. Terms · Privacy
  • Microsoft Clarity. With a Clarity connection, your pages load the Clarity script (clarity.ms), which records how visitors use the page. Terms · Privacy
  • Webhooks. With a webhook connection, the events you choose (a new user, a new comment, a published post…) are sent to the URL you enter, signed with your secret. You decide where that is.
  • Telegram. With a Telegram connection, the alerts you choose are sent to your chat through api.telegram.org, with the bot token you enter. Terms · Privacy
  • Email (SMTP). With an SMTP connection, your site’s emails go through the mail server you enter (your hosting, Gmail, Brevo…).
  • AI keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter). When you save or test a key, OG Connectors asks that provider for its list of models to check that the key works. Nothing else is sent. OpenAI · Anthropic · Google · Mistral · DeepSeek · Groq · OpenRouter
  • Testing a connection sends one test request to that service, only when you press “Test”.
  • OnlyGrow (api.onlygrow.co). Only if you choose to help improve the OnlyGrow plugins, in the welcome steps or on the plugin’s screens. Your site then shares its address, the versions of its OnlyGrow plugins and whether they are still in use, and the IP address of the administrator, from which the country it is managed from is worked out. With that same yes, Tools → Improve your site loads the list of OnlyGrow plugins from there. Nothing about your visitors is shared, and the plugin works the same if you say no.

Do I need OG Analytics?

Only for Attribution (which ad or link brought each conversion). OG Analytics is our free analytics plugin; OG Connectors offers to install it from WordPress.org with one click, never on its own.
sections.changelog:
0.2.06

  • [[new]] The welcome steps now show what you gain over the plugins you already use, next to the free version of each one.
  • [[added]] Attribution can use more click IDs: gad_source (Google Ads), yclid (Yandex), oppref (ChatGPT ads), pin_cid (Pinterest), sccid and snap_cid (Snapchat), mc_cid and mc_eid (Mailchimp). Choose them in Settings → Attribution.
  • [[improved]] Old log entries are now deleted by a WordPress scheduled task, every hour and in small batches, following the days you chose in Settings → Data. Busy sites no longer delete everything at once, and quiet sites still clean up.

0.2.05

  • [[feature]] Tools → Diagnose checks whether your browser reaches the site’s API (/wp-json/). If an ad blocker, a VPN, a security plugin or a firewall blocks it, it says which screens are affected and what to allow, instead of leaving them empty.
  • [[new]] Tools → Improve your site: the other free OnlyGrow plugins, in one place. The list only loads if you choose to share.
  • [[new]] You can help improve the OnlyGrow plugins from a notice at the top of the screens and from Tools → Diagnose. It’s optional, nothing about your visitors is shared, and closing the notice hides it for 15 days.
  • [[new]] AI agents can see the limits of this version and what the site already uses, and read the fields of a pixel rule. With «act» on (Settings → AI agents), they can also change where a pixel loads.
  • [[improved]] Phone numbers now reach Meta and TikTok in international format before they are hashed, using the billing country or your store’s country, so more of your sales can be matched. A number without a valid format is no longer sent.
  • [[improved]] AI agents no longer see webhook addresses, chats or email recipients, only the settings that are safe to read.
  • [[changed]] Pixel rules and custom events use a simple list of conditions. Rules you already saved with groups keep working and you can still edit them.
  • [[fixed]] AI agents: some requests failed when they were called with no data, or with empty data.

0.2.04

  • [[feature]] Email that gets through: a chain of backup connections (A → B → C, never the same one twice), routing by sender (an email from sales@ goes out through the connection that can send as sales@), and if every connection fails, one automatic retry 30 minutes later («Retry now» sends it sooner).
  • [[feature]] Activity groups the attempts of each send: one row per email with its final result and a dot per attempt; open it to see every attempt and what happened in each one.
  • [[feature]] Tools → Diagnose: a green, amber and red checklist of your setup with what to do for each item, the SPF, DKIM and DMARC of your sender’s domain, and a report you can copy for support.
  • [[feature]] 29 more WordPress events for your alerts, in new groups (Media, Plugins and themes, Privacy, Security and site) and more for comments, posts and users: failed logins (with a limit per user and IP), WordPress updated, plugin deleted, user email changed, admin email changed, updates available…
  • [[feature]] Settings → AI agents: let AI agents read your connections and your activity through the WordPress Abilities API, and choose whether they can act (off by default).
  • [[new]] n8n, Zapier, Make and Pabbly Connect in «Add connection», each with its own steps.
  • [[new]] Every email: a hidden copy (BCC), a Reply-To and your own headers, for all emails or per connection (Settings → Email).
  • [[new]] Deliver only to the domains you choose, so a staging copy of your site doesn’t email real people, and turn off WordPress emails one by one (Settings → Email).
  • [[new]] Each email says who sent it («via WooCommerce») and, in a tooltip, the file and line that sent it. The «New user» alert also says which plugin or file created the account.
  • [[new]] «How to fix» next to a failed email or test, the SMTP conversation of each attempt (without passwords or the message), and «Check which ports» under the server of an email connection.
  • [[new]] A button under your Telegram alerts that opens the post, comment or order of the event (a checkbox per event).
  • [[new]] A sale is never counted twice: reloading or going back to the thank-you page no longer sends the purchase again.
  • [[new]] If Facebook for WooCommerce uses the same Meta pixel as OG Connectors, its tracking is paused so every event reaches Meta once (its product catalog keeps working). Tools → Diagnose also warns about other plugins that load pixels.
  • [[new]] Meta domain verification: paste the code (or the whole meta tag) in your Meta pixel and it goes in the head of every page.
  • [[improved]] The admin screens have been redesigned to keep improving your experience: the sections of Settings → Email, Settings → Attribution, Settings → AI agents and Settings → Data are cards with one line on what they do, the switches sit to the left of their text, and the tabs and filters look like WordPress.
  • [[improved]] «Add connection» asks first what you want to connect, then the service and its name, with an example for each service.
  • [[improved]] Up to 2 email (SMTP) connections: your main one and its backup. A new one comes with «Use this sender in every email» on.
  • [[improved]] The history of a connection says the role of each attempt (backup, retry, routing), and «See the whole send» opens it in Activity.
  • [[improved]] Each pixel and tag ID shows an example of its format, next to where to find it.
  • [[changed]] A comment caught as spam no longer sends «New comment»: it goes to «Comment marked as spam», which now also catches the comments Akismet marks as they arrive.
  • [[changed]] OG Connectors now needs WordPress 6.9 or newer (for the Abilities API).
  • [[fixed]] An email that failed in another plugin with unusual data could stop the page with an error.
  • [[fixed]] The «View details» window of an update showed the labels of the changelog as plain text.

0.2.03

  • [[fixed]] Dashboard: the emails your site sends without an SMTP connection of OG Connectors (under «WordPress») were not counted in Deliveries.

0.2.02

  • [[feature]] Dashboard: the totals of your deliveries and your tracking, a chart by day and a «By time of day» grid, for the dates, type and provider you choose.
  • [[feature]] Activity: search, select several entries to resend or delete them at once, and clear by dates and filters (it tells you how many before deleting).
  • [[feature]] See every email your site sent: its headers and its body (as it looks or as code), and resend it, sent or failed.
  • [[feature]] Settings → Data: choose how long Activity, the content of the emails and Tracking are kept. Conversions are kept forever.
  • [[new]] Email simulation in Settings → Email: your site’s emails are logged but not delivered (for a staging copy of the site).
  • [[new]] Choose whether the sent emails and the failed ones are logged (Settings → Email).
  • [[new]] Alerts about OG Connectors itself: «Email failed», «Connection failing» and «Connection working again», through the channel you choose.
  • [[new]] Send a test email to any address, as HTML or plain text, from the Test button of an email connection.
  • [[new]] Emails your site sends without an SMTP connection of OG Connectors are logged too (under «WordPress»).
  • [[improved]] «Product viewed» is still sent to Meta, TikTok and Google on every product page, but it is no longer logged in Tracking: it made too many entries and slowed the site down. With OG Analytics, it is logged in each visit.
  • [[improved]] The time each email takes is measured, and a time of 0 ms no longer lowers the average.
  • [[improved]] Settings in tabs: Email, Attribution and Data.
  • [[improved]] The history of a connection has the same actions as Activity: view the email, resend, delete.
  • [[improved]] Activity is now the second menu entry, and the logs show the 200 newest entries.
  • [[improved]] On a new site, the examples start with your email (SMTP), then Meta, Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager and Telegram.
  • [[fixed]] A date picker inside a window opened behind it.

0.2.01

  • [[feature]] A brand-new OG Connectors: one place for every connection your site makes to the outside world, each with its own test and status.
  • [[feature]] Pixels and tags: Meta, TikTok, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Microsoft Clarity, with rules for where each one loads.
  • [[feature]] Conversion events for every pixel, from the browser and, for Meta, also from your server (Conversions API) with the same event ID.
  • [[feature]] Alerts: send WordPress events (new user, new comment, published post…) to webhooks, Telegram or email, with your own templates.
  • [[feature]] Email (SMTP): your site’s emails through the server you choose, with a backup connection and a log of every email.
  • [[new]] Tracking: a log of every conversion sent, with its answer, filters and CSV export.
  • [[new]] Activity: a log of every connection, alerts for the ones that keep failing and one-click resend for a failed webhook.
  • [[new]] Attribution: which ad or link brought each conversion, first or last touch (with OG Analytics).
  • [[new]] AI keys: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq and OpenRouter, tested when saved.
  • [[new]] A short welcome guide the first time you open the plugin.
  • [[new]] An example of every connection, switched off, so you can see everything it does and fill in the one you need.
  • [[improved]] Each delivery goes out only once, even if two background tasks run at the same time.
  • [[improved]] A warning when another plugin is already sending your site’s emails.
